_doc: Comparison and showcase screenshots, shared by every client (tools/screenshots/README.md). Positions are server (Kod) squares in the room `rid`, standing at the square's centre; `angle` is Kod's 0-4095 (0 east, 1024 south, 2048 west, 3072 north). `clients` says who takes the shot: classic, modern, mobile (tools/screenshots/capture.ts), unreal (meridian-unreal tools/ue/run_comparison_shots.ps1) and original (by hand). `steps` run after the character is placed (README).
